description: Hydrosystem calculates hydraulic and thermal behaviour of industrial pipelines and selects diameters. The provider describes branched and looped networks, above- and below-ground pipes, equipment sizing and water-hammer calculations. The provider is NTP Truboprovod. Required modules and input assumptions should be checked before procurement or use. For simulation it supports pipeline design, operating checks and transient-pressure studies.
